source.title: Owner selection of initial platform, compatibility policy and 1.1 release train

selected.mutation_filesystem: local NTFS under explicitly authorized roots
selected.deployment_scope: managed-portable first plus user-scope integrations explicitly admitted by the release contract
selected.setup_implementation: native kernel, worker and independent recovery path
selected.appearance_default: System Native with bounded data-only OEM+ branding

non_claims: not a minimum supported OS declaration
does not remove Linux, macOS or historical compatibility programmes

selected.existing_c_abi: preserve ABI 1.0 callers, symbols, calling conventions, layouts and ownership/lifetime rules
selected.new_capabilities: prefer new functions and explicitly versioned records
selected.contract_identity: never change an admitted schema identity while silently changing its meaning
selected.breaking_change_rule: use an explicit breaking boundary rather than conceal incompatibility under 1.1.0

required_analysis: old persisted state to new reader
new persisted state to old reader
outstanding: reviewed migration for each promoted contract
executable compatibility tests for each actual change

OD-008.product_objective: A developer can define a product without forking Universal Setup, generate its setup package, install and maintain it through the shared SDK and user interfaces, and recover every supported interrupted operation.
required_families: CLI, machine mode, both TUI modes and first native OEM+ shell
SDK, setup envelopes, independent recovery and exact distribution inventory
consumer, interruption, package and accessibility qualification
scheduled_later: fleet administration and broad prerequisite orchestration
